name: Oshioki Maribel
source:
Maribel goes on a journey and starts to travel with a female warrior. But girls aren't strong enough to defend from some particularly strong monsters...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-january-2006-io.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
瑪莉貝爾踏上旅途，與一名女戰士結伴同行。然而，面對某些格外強大的怪物，她們的實力不足以保護自己……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-january-2006-io.html]vndbreview[/url]]
